Your first lap shows you what Parley does, and recordings file themselves.

- **Getting started.** Load the bundled sample call and a checklist walks you through filing it, replaying it and sharing it to your AI with a ready-made prompt.
- **Filing suggestions.** When a recording stops, Parley proposes a title and a folder.
- **Folders and organizations in the Library**, with a default save location.
- **Imports report transcription failures** and sync once the network or the app comes back.
- **Speech during a reconnect is no longer lost**, and the live screen shows what the microphone is doing.
